//: French customs ELO (API_BREXIT_ELO). Three deviations from the published spec, each
preserveHeaderParameters: Authorization is a real per-call parameter here, not a transport
concern. The ELO spec declares no security scheme at all, so the caller supplies the bearer
token as a method argument alongside messageCode/functionalId/messageId/correlationId.
overrideProperties: the spec declares 'pdf' as { type: string, enum: [formatbytebase64] } — a
single-value enum naming an encoding rather than carrying content. Its own worked examples
send real base64 in that field, so a generated string-enum converter throws on every
response that has a barcode, which is every successful create and retrieve. Plain string,
not format:byte: NJsonSchema would emit byte[] and decode inside the deserialiser, turning a
malformed value into a crash instead of something a worker can dead-letter.
The examples also put 'pdf' beside 'enveloppe' rather than inside it, disagreeing with the
schema, so both placements are bound and a caller reads whichever arrived.
keepComponents: ENV_NOT01 is the passage notification (APPAIRAGE/EMBARQUEMENT/DEBARQUEMENT)
French customs pushes to an operator's callback URL. No path returns it, so pruning would
drop it, but it is exactly the DTO a future caller needs in order to deserialise one.
